estonia.title: Harles Tammeleht: Business tourism could help Tallinn hotels survive the winter
estonia.description: A conference center at Tallinn's Linnahall could bring visitors during the low season and help hotels and restaurants operate year-round, writes Harles Tammeleht.

estonia.title: French hosts strip Estonia of quadcross 3rd place, hand it to France
estonia.description: The FIM SidecarCross & QuadCross and of Nations round in Dardon-Gueugnon, France, ended in a major setback for Estonia as the team was stripped of third place.

estonia.title: Estonia prioritizes national defense, postpones Rail Baltica completion in 2027 budget
estonia.description: Next year's state budget projects €20.2 billion in spending and €19.4 billion in revenue. The deficit is forecast at 4 percent of GDP.

estonia.title: Estonian kids increasingly experience fear of school
estonia.description: In recent years, the number of students who find going to school extremely frightening or unpleasant has grown.

estonia.title: Expert: Ukraine's recent success an operational-level breakthrough
estonia.description: Ukraine's successful offensive near Lyman has achieved an operational breakthrough that could be repeated elsewhere, Maj. Gen. (Ret.) Neeme Väli told ERR.

estonia.title: Minister: Trump-Zelenskyy UN encounter did not bring peace any closer
estonia.description: US President Donald Trump and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's recent meeting did little to advance the Ukraine peace process, Foreign Minister Tsahkna (Eesti 200) said.

estonia.title: 7-year sentence handed down to Oleg Bessedin for anti-Estonia activities
estonia.description: A court has found a pro-Kremlin propagandist guilty of crimes against Estonia's independence, sovereignty and territorial integrity.

estonia.title: Almost all forms of heating to become more expensive for Estonians this winter
estonia.description: Prices for nearly all types of heating will rise as the heating season gets underway. The increase will be particularly steep for those who heat with natural gas, as its price on the global market has more than doubled.

estonia.title: NATO aircrews training in Estonia again this week
estonia.description: NATO air defense aircraft based in the Baltic states are conducting training flights in Estonian airspace this week, including low-level flights.

estonia.title: Estonia law change will allow domestic cellphone roaming during crises
estonia.description: From Thursday, mobile customers in Estonia will be able switch to a rival operator's network if their own is damaged during a crisis situation.

estonia.title: Rae child protection services strained by migrants claiming to be minors
estonia.description: Child protection services in Rae Municipality, just outside Tallinn, are under pressure from the number of cases of migrants who are minors authorities are having to process.

estonia.title: Mass publication of data on deceased persons makes historians' work easier
estonia.description: In September, the Ministry of the Interior began publishing, as open data, the names, birth and death dates, and personal identification codes of deceased persons. For historians and name researchers, machine‑readable data makes research easier.

estonia.title: Survey: most employees handle personal matters during working hours
estonia.description: A CV.ee survey shows that the strict line between working time and personal time has long blurred in many workplaces.

estonia.title: St. Nicholas' Church recreated in Lego after 18‑month fan effort
estonia.description: Enthusiast Nikolai Mordan's recent interest has been building Lego versions of well‑known Tallinn buildings.

estonia.title: Estonia to hold regular National Defense Council meetings
estonia.description: Until now, the meetings of the National Defense Council have taken place ad hoc at the president's invitation, but the next Estonian president, Ülle Madise, wants to make the institution's work systematic, said future presidential adviser Taimar Peterkop.

estonia.title: Mart Meri: 'Silverwhite' stayed with my father until the end
estonia.description: Philologist Mart Meri says the themes of "Silverwhite" stayed with his father, Lennart Meri, until the end of his life, surfacing even in his presidential speeches.

estonia.title: Marko Mihkelson: Defeatism is not deterrence
estonia.description: The snowball of speculation about an imminent Russian attack on Europe is gathering pace. Isolated facts are being mixed with wishful thinking, worst-case scenarios and, at times, little more than the need to grab attention, writes Marko Mihkelson.

estonia.title: Tattoo culture researcher: Women have always been the main source of inspiration
estonia.description: Tattoo artist and researcher of Estonian tattoo culture Oskar Poll told ETV that while tattoos during the Soviet era often featured maritime motifs and women, the range of subjects has since expanded considerably.

estonia.title: Mikk Kasesalk: Estonian culture has no other refuge anywhere in the world
estonia.description: Estonia's competitiveness must largely rely on capable, educated people, but that idea is under pressure as the education system's capacity fails to keep pace with demand, writes Mikk Kasesalk.

estonia.title: EIS to spend millions promoting Estonia and its e‑residency program worldwide
estonia.description: The Estonian Business and Innovation Agency (EIS) is running several major procurements to market Estonia abroad, including up to €1 million for promoting the e‑residency program and up to €3 million for tourism business marketing.

estonia.title: Martin Mölder: Politicians' battle over attention and memory
estonia.description: The opposition wants voters under no circumstances to forget what happened in the previous elections — namely broken promises and the hiding of their real political intentions, notes Martin Mölder.

estonia.title: Youth today have more chances to experiment, says Pärnu street artist
estonia.description: Pärnu street artist Kristjan Tamm, known as Kryptik, says young artists today have more legal chances to learn street art than when he first started more than 20 years ago.

estonia.title: Ukrainian honorary consulate opens in Tartu municipality
estonia.description: The Ukrainian honorary consulate opened Saturday in Tartu municipality, aiming to deepen Estonia‑Ukraine cooperation and assist Ukrainians in southern Estonia.

estonia.title: Local governments set for major funding overhaul next year
estonia.description: Local governments will, beginning next year with the planned change, gain greater freedom to decide over their finances. This is something municipalities have awaited, though in the first year it may punch a hole in the budget of some rural municipalities.

estonia.title: Eesti.ai trainers risk pay cuts if participant feedback falls short
estonia.description: A service provider teaching artificial intelligence under Eesti.ai may not receive the full fee agreed in the contract. The Government Office may pay only half the price or not pay it at all if participant feedback from the training falls below the required level or if too few participants provide feedback.

estonia.title: Estonian Military Orchestra marks anniversary with concerts in Viljandi and Tallinn
estonia.description: The Estonian Military Orchestra will celebrate the 108th anniversary of Estonian military music and the fifth anniversary of operating within the Estonian War Museum with birthday concerts on 7 October at Viljandi Pauluse Church and on 8 October at the Estonia Concert Hall in Tallinn.

estonia.title: Cyberattack gains access to University of Tartu library's online store customer data
estonia.description: The University of Tartu Library informed users of its e‑bookstore that an external attacker gained access to their online store and most likely downloaded the store's customer data.

estonia.title: Kristian Sirp: Estonia's bigger defense budget requires smarter procurers
estonia.description: Estonia has good reason to invest heavily in security in the coming years, but a larger budget also means greater responsibility for the technological choices we make, as more equipment does not automatically translate into greater capability, Kristian Sirp writes.

estonia.title: Lenin promised nations the right to secede, but built a centralized state
estonia.description: As the Russian Empire collapsed, self‑determination became a powerful political tool. It was used to demand autonomy and independence as well as to justify new systems of governance. A doctoral dissertation defended at the University of Tartu examined how and why different political forces harnessed self‑determination for their own interests in the early 20th century.

estonia.title: Health Insurance Fund chief: healthcare pay rises must reflect real possibilities
estonia.description: The head of the Health Insurance Fund's management board, Siiri Lahe, said regarding the healthcare unions' demands for pay increases that they do responsible and important work and their pay must keep pace with the times, but at the same time one must proceed from real possibilities.

estonia.title: Tartu researchers develop blood test to identify genetic causes of pregnancy loss
estonia.description: Researchers at the University of Tartu's Institute of Molecular and Cell Biology are testing a solution that makes it possible to determine the cause of pregnancy loss based on a blood test.

estonia.title: Gallery: Lennart Meri's epic 'Silverwhite' journey brought to life
estonia.description: 50 years after its publication, the Estonian Maritime Museum has brought Lennart Meri's epic "Silverwhite" journey to life with a new exhibition at Tallinn Seaplane Harbor.

estonia.title: Estonian choreographer's ballets to premiere as two-part evening in Tartu
estonia.description: Two of Estonian choreographer Jevgeni Grib's ballets will share the stage for the first time Saturday as Vanemuine Theater pairs "Keep a Light in the Window" with "Tango."

estonia.title: Higher‑ranking civil servants set for another pay rise
estonia.description: Although Finance Minister Jürgen Ligi criticized the tone with which rescue workers and teachers demand higher pay, the salaries of higher‑ranking state employees rise every year without anyone needing to protest, because their pay increases are indexed.

estonia.title: NATO deputy supreme commander: If we must attack to defend, that's what we'll do
estonia.description: NATO would strike targets on another country's territory if needed to defend its members, NATO's top commander in Europe, Air Chief Marshal Sir Johnny Stringer told Postimees.

estonia.title: Government sets 2032 target for Rail Baltica's Tallinn–Pärnu section
estonia.description: Although the completion of Rail Baltica is being postponed, work continues on the sections already started. The Tallinn–Pärnu section should be completed in 2032.

estonia.title: Varja wind farm scaled back by one‑third in revised plan
estonia.description: In Ida‑Virumaa's Lüganuse municipality, the planning of the first part of the Varja wind farm is nearing completion, and construction of 12 turbines should begin next year. Compared with the original plan, the park has become one‑third smaller.

estonia.title: Farmers use 'empty planting' schemes to obtain subsidies
estonia.description: In Estonia, vegetable cultivation has multiplied several times in just a couple of years, but some farmers sow crops only to receive subsidies and have no intention of harvesting them. Such scheming, however, leaves real farmers in trouble.

estonia.title: Court rules Estonian municipality lacked grounds to end wind farm planning
estonia.description: Tallinn Administrative Court overturned a Kose Municipal Council decision to end local wind farm planning, citing procedural concerns as well as bad or insufficient data.

estonia.title: Court convicts Kohtla‑Järve drug ring connected to two substance‑related deaths
estonia.description: A court has convicted a Kohtla‑Järve drug gang led by a Latvian couple who trafficked narcotics from Latvia into Estonia.

estonia.title: Tartu wants to buy 1,000 new rental bikes
estonia.description: To ensure the long-term success of its bike-share system, Tartu wants to acquire 1,000 new electric bikes compatible with the existing system.

estonia.title: Months later, Estonian Navy patrol vessel still out of service
estonia.description: The Estonian Navy patrol vessel Raju has been out of service since spring and may remain so for another six months after repairs in dry dock failed to go as planned.

estonia.title: Expert: Drop in Center Party support tied to shrinking backing among Russian‑speaking voters
estonia.description: The decline in the Center Party's rating in surveys is connected to the decrease in their support among Russian‑speaking respondents, while the rise in the Reform Party's rating may be associated with their remaining at the center of media attention, says Emor research expert Aivar Voog.

estonia.title: Estonia launches joint study to map optimal electricity mix by 2027
estonia.description: Estonia's Chamber of Commerce, major energy companies and government have launched a joint effort to determine the most cost‑efficient mix of electricity generation, storage and cross‑border connections needed to meet the country's rising power demand.

estonia.title: International nightlife conference to be held in Tallinn in October
estonia.description: The international night culture conference "Dance Floor of Democracy" will take place at Tallinn's HALL club October 9, bringing together European night culture leaders, city officials, researchers and artists.

estonia.title: Estonia's only artichoke farmer sees bright future for local crop
estonia.description: Estonia's only dedicated artichoke grower says this summer's conditions were ideal for the crop, now thriving after years of testing different varieties and growing methods.

estonia.title: Defense official: Russia's neighbors have stepped up responses to air threats
estonia.description: Due to Russia's war of aggression in Ukraine, more and more drones and even cruise missiles have ended up in neighboring countries, which is why the Baltic states and Poland have strengthened measures for responding to air threats, said Gert Kaju, head of the Ministry of Defense's defense readiness department.

estonia.title: Prosecutors launch criminal probe into Maardu football match-fixing case
estonia.description: Prosecutors have launched criminal proceedings over suspected betting fraud in a second-tier Esiliiga match involving Maardu Linnameeskond.

estonia.title: Lihtsad uudised 25. septembril
estonia.description: "Lihtsad uudised," meaning easy or simple news, is for anyone who wants to improve their Estonian language skills. Listen and read a selection of this week's news stories below.

estonia.title: Finance minister: Those getting a positive exception should not complain about pay
estonia.description: Rescue workers' pay will rise faster than inflation or by roughly the same amount and those whose demands are being met should not complain too much, Finance Minister Jürgen Ligi (Reform) said.

estonia.title: «Ma ei taha veel kaks aastat pingutada.» Olümpiavõitja tõmbas ootamatult sportlaskarjäärile joone alla
estonia.description: Trekisprindi olümpiavõitja Katy Marchant teatas ootamatult, et loobub jalgrattaspordist, kuigi algselt oli tema plaan võistelda ka 2028. aastal Los Angelese olümpiamängudel.

estonia.title: Riigikokku jõuab Vene ja Valgevene kodanike kinnisvaraoste piirav eelnõu
estonia.description: Maaelukomisjon kiitis 28. septembri istungil heaks eelnõu, mille eesmärk on tugevdada Eesti julgeolekut ja piirata Venemaa ning Valgevenega seotud isikute võimalusi omandada Eestis kinnisasju.

estonia.title: Unistuste suhe: peamine märk, et oled leidnud selle õige
estonia.description: Mõnikord ei teki kõige teravam üksindustunne mitte siis, kui oleme täiesti üksi, vaid hoopis siis, kui meie kõrval on inimene, kes meid tegelikult ei näe.

estonia.title: ÜLEVAADE ⟩ Le Peni erakond alustas marssi Prantsuse riigitüüri juurde
estonia.description: Prantsusmaa parempopulistliku erakonna Rahvuslik Liit (RN) ja nendega koostööd tegevad väiksemad erakonnad kindlustasid pühapäevastel parlamendi 348-kohalise ülemkoja valimistel rekordarvu kohti. Tegemist on tormihoiatusega rohkem kui poole aasta pärast toimuvatele presidendivalimistele.

estonia.title: Tervisekassa pääses halvimast: valitsuse lahendus hoiab ära raviteenuste kahanemise
estonia.description: Valitsuse värskete riigieelarve strateegiat puudutavate otsuste kohaselt suunatakse vaimse tervise, ohvriabi ja sõltuvusravi toetuseks igal aastal miljoneid eurosid lisaraha. Lisaks on võetud kindel kurss Tervisekassa päästmiseks ähvardavast kriisist, viies selle eelarve kümnendi lõpuks taas kindlasse tasakaalu.

estonia.title: Opositsioon tõmbas kliimaseaduse arutelule selleks nädalaks kriipsu peale
estonia.description: Riigikogu keskkonnakomisjon ei kinnitanud täna nädala töökava, mis tähendab, et toppama jääb ka arutelu kliimaseaduse ümber.

estonia.title: ARVAMUS ⟩ Mida ootame koolidelt ja ülikoolilt, kui masin kirjutab essee sekunditega – mida üldse siis hinnata?
estonia.description: Tartu Ülikooli genoomikainstituudi kaasprofessor Toomas Haller toob meie ette kõne, mida ta eeldaks, et oleks viimane aeg ette kanda näiteks sellesama ülikooli aulas. See on kõne, mille neljapunktiline selgus ja põhjalikkus lahkab ülima täpsusega vastuolusid, mille lahendamata jätmine võib meid – nii eestlasi, kui inimkonda laiemaltki – lootusetusse ummikusse viia. Selle kõnega on seotud aga nüanss, millest allpool täpsemalt *.

estonia.title: Robert Kangur pääses Itaalia kõrgliiga mängus esimest korda platsile
estonia.description: Robert Kangur ja tema koduklubi Varese kaotas pühapäeval Itaalia kõrgliiga esimeses kohtumises Euroliiga meeskonnale Bologna Virtus 69:90.

estonia.title: WSJ ⟩ Kas Putin päriselt pidas mind spiooniks?
estonia.description: Ta nõjatus ettepoole ja lükkas mu kätte dokumendid. Paberid olid korralikult kirjutatud, musta pastakaga, ning esmapilgul seisid seal ametlikud tootmismahtude tabelid.

estonia.title: Michal: Rail Balticu tähtaja nihkumine lükkab edasi ka teede valmimist
estonia.description: Tänasel järgmise aasta riigieelarve tutvustamisel tõdes peaminister Kristen Michal muu hulgas, et paralleelselt Rail Balticu edasilükkumisega nihkuvad edasi ka teede valmimise tähtajad.

estonia.title: 2027 RIIGIEELARVE ⟩ Investeeringute ja investeerimistoetuste prioriteet pole kaitse
estonia.description: Kui võtta kokku 2027. aastaks eelarvestrateegias olevad tegevusvaldkonnad, siis prioriteet pole investeeringute ja investeerimistoetuste osas kaitse, vaid kliima. 253-leheküljelises dokumendis on igasugu mõõdikuid, investeeringutest ja investeerimistoetustest on väga vähe konkreetset informatsiooni.

estonia.title: Ralliajakirjanik Colin Clark: ujun Otepääl alasti üle jõe, kui Tänak WRC-s ei sõida
estonia.description: Tunnustatud ralliajakirjanik ja portaalile Dirtfish kaastööd tegev Colin Clark on üsna veendunud, et Ott Tänak naaseb tuleval aastal ralli tippseltskonda. Seepärast julges ta välja käia pealkirjas mainitud lubaduse.

estonia.title: Uuel töökohal alustanud Arnold Oksmaa pälvib klientidelt ohtralt kiidusõnu: ma pole üheski poes näinud kiiremat ja töökamat inimest
estonia.description: Laulja ja meelelahutaja Arnold Oksmaa on oma senisest töökohast Maximas edasi liikunud ning teenindab nüüd kliente Selveris. Töökohavahetus tuli avalikuks Threadsi postitusest, mille alla kogunes hulgaliselt südamlikke kommentaare. «Ma tahtsin edasi liikuda ja areneda,» põhjendas Oksmaa muutust Elu24-le.

estonia.title: Arstide liidu terav nõue: riigiasutuste ligipääs terviseandmetele tuleb kohe sulgeda
estonia.description: Eesti Arstide Liit tegi avaliku pöördumise sotsiaalminister Karmen Jollerile, nõudes riigiasutuste ligipääsu viivitamatut sulgemist patsientide terviseandmetele, kui selleks puudub inimese enda nõusolek. Arstide sõnul on praegune olukord, kus andmetele pääsevad ligi politsei ja teised asutused, lubamatu ning seab tõsisesse ohtu patsiendi ja arsti vahelise usalduse.

estonia.title: AJAKAVA ⟩ Suur finaal Sardiinias: WRC tiitlile konkureerivad Evans, Pajari ja Solberg. Kes jääb peale?
estonia.description: Autoralli MM-hooaeg lõpeb sel nädalavahetusel Vahemere saarel Sardiinias, sõitjate MM-tiitli nimel heitlevad kolm Toyota sõitjat – Elfyn Evans, Sami Pajari ja Oliver Solberg. WRC2 maailmameistritena tulevad starti Robert Virves ja Jakko Viilo (Škoda). Ralli algab neljapäeva hommikul kl 10 testikatsega.

estonia.title: TOIVO RÄÄGEL ⟩ Kulutame riigikaitseks iga kaheksanda, mitte kahekümnenda maksueuro
estonia.description: Lisaks Rail Balticu edasilükkamisele tuleks ka riigikaitselisi kulutusi riigieelarves vähendada, leiab majandusküberneetik Toivo Räägel.

estonia.title: Eesti veemotosportlased võitsid vaatamata jões hulpivale prahile MMil kaks medalit
estonia.description: Kolm Eesti veemotosportlast jõudsid möödunud nädalavahetusel Itaalias San Nazzaros GT30 paadiklassi maailmameistrivõistlustel nelja parema hulka ja kaks neist võitsid medali.

estonia.title: Raamatute edetabeli tippu tõusis teos luuletajast, keda pole siiani lõpuni mõistetud
estonia.description: Apollo raamatute müügiedetabeli esikohale on jõudnud Mihkel Muti värskelt ilmunud teos Juhan Viidingust. Raamat vaatleb Viidingut nii luuletaja, näitleja, lavastaja ja bardina kui ka erakordse inimesena ning heidab pilgu tema ajastule ja kaasteelistele.

estonia.title: ÜLEVAADE ⟩ Kohalik talunik paljastas terrorirünnaku plaani Briti õhuväebaasile
estonia.description: Laupäeva öösel peolt koju sõitnud kohalik elanik märkas Fairfordi õhuväebaasi lähedal kahtlasi kaubikuid ja teavitas asjast politseid. Naise tähelepanelikkus võis aidata hoida ära terrorirünnaku baasile, kus võõrustatakse Ameerika Ühendriikide strateegilisi pommitajaid.

estonia.title: Noorte meeste seas levib ohtlik mõtteviis: «Kui hoolid vaid iseendast, ei saa keegi sind haavata»
estonia.description: Oleme harjunud mõtlema, et noorel mehel on (või peaks olema) elus kaks peamist eesmärki: teenida raha ning endasse investeerida. Kumbki neist pole ju halb – raha on vaja, et ellu jääda ning endasse investeerimine teeb sinust aja jooksul tugevama ja suutlikuma inimese. Küll aga jääb selle taga varju üks oluline isikuomadus: empaatia. Ülimalt oluline on ka teistega arvestada ning mõista nende muresid.

latvia.title: A new era for European defense?
latvia.description: Europe’s defense ministers are meeting today to discuss whether the EU needs its own version of NATO’s article 4. This so-called Emergency Security Protocol would allow capitals to bring together all EU countries in the event of a security crisis. But the idea is controversial. On the show, hosts Zoya Sheftalovich and Nick Vinocur discuss […]

latvia.title: Orbán Anita: Konzervatív, valláspárti kormány vagyunk
latvia.description: A külügyminiszter a Newsweeknek adott interjúban az orosz–magyar kapcsolatról is beszélt.

latvia.title: Bóka János: A Fidesz elégtételt fog venni azokon, akik asszisztáltak a Hankóék elleni eljáráshoz
latvia.description: „Nem szöktem el, nem rejtőztem el, és a jövőben sem fogok elszökni” – közölte Hankó Balázs még a mentelmi jogának felfüggesztése előtt. A fideszes politikus azt mondja, a Parlament épületében marad, és a munkahelyén várja meg, milyen intézkedést kívánnak vele szemben foganatosítani.

latvia.title: "Kényelmes helyzetben vagyunk" - Megszólalt az ÁKK vezére Magyarország finanszírozásáról
latvia.description: Az idei állami gazdálkodás felismerhetetlenül eltávolodott az eredeti terveitől, a költségvetés úgy kilyukadt, hogy több ezer milliárd forinttal több hitelforrás bevonására kényszerül. Mindez kihat a teljes adósságkezelésre, amelyről jelenleg nincsenek pontos ismereteink, hiszen az Államadósságkezelő Központ (ÁKK) adósságfinanszírozási terve a költségvetéssel együtt avult el. Ma viszont sokat tisztul a kép, hiszen hétfői sajtótájékoztatóján Tardos Gergely, az ÁKK vezérigazgatója bemutatja a szervezet idei friss finanszírozási tervét.

latvia.title: Seszták Miklós máris az ügyészségre ment
latvia.description: Az Országgyűlés felfüggesztette Seszták Miklós korábbi fejlesztési miniszter mentelmi jogát, akit azzal gyanúsítanak, hogy hivatali ideje alatt összesen több mint 12 milliárd forintnyi kenőpénzt fogadott el. A KDNP-s képviselő a szavazást követően azonnal az ügyészségre ment, hogy vallomást tegyen, miközben tagadja a bűncselekmény elkövetését. Az ügy másik főszereplője, a Magyar Nemzeti Vagyonkezelő egykori vezérigazgatója már letartóztatásban van - tudósított a 24.hu .

latvia.title: Marta Cienkowska wzięła udział w pokazie mody. Ministra kultury odpowiada na krytykę
latvia.description: Ministra kultury Marta Cienkowska wzięła udział w pokazie mody zorganizowanym przez Fundację Kraina, co wywołało krytykę części polityków. Zarzucono jej między innymi, że występ był następstwem dotacji resortu kultury w wysokości około 150 tysięcy złotych. "Mój udział w pokazie był pro bono" - zaznacza natomiast w oświadczeniu Cienkowska.

latvia.title: W kajdankach na front? Nie tak wygląda mobilizacja w Ukrainie
latvia.description: Miliony wyświetleń zdobyło nagranie, które rzekomo pokazuje Ukraińców skutych kajdankami i siłą wysyłanych na front. Opublikował je też poseł Włodzimierz Skalik. Niektórzy do filmu dołączali podobne zdjęcie mężczyzn siedzących w autobusie - również w kajdankach. Ukraina ma problemy z mobilizacją, ale te materiały ich nie dokumentują.

latvia.title: Uniunea Europeană vrea să îşi consolideze răspunsul în fața atacurile hibride ruseşti
latvia.description: Uniunea Europeană va discuta, luni, posibila înfiinţare a propriului mecanism de urgenţă, inspirat de cel al NATO, pentru a consolida răspunsul comun la „atacurile hibride” atribuite Moscovei, a indicat şefa politicii externe a UE, Kaja Kallas, relatează AFP, potrivit Agerpres.

latvia.title: Europa, o broască în oala NATO pe focul întreținut de Putin. Scenariul rus de destrămare a alianței nord-atlantice: escaladare treptată
latvia.description: Cum ar putea arăta un război între Rusia și NATO? Jurnalistul Michael Kranz oferă un posibil scenariu pe platforma Unherd. În largul insulei Hiiumaa, istoria este pe cale să se scrie. O flotă combinată de nave de război ale NATO - condusă de distrugătoare ale Marinei Regale Britanice și alcătuită din reprezentanți ai cinci țări - se îndreaptă spre această insulă bătută de vânturi, situată la gura Golfului Finlandei. Chiar în față se află Flota Baltică a Rusiei, care, în ultimele 36 de ore, a încercat să impună un blocaj naval asupra Estoniei. Mai la est, s-au adunat și 100.000 de soldați ruși, iar Vladimir Putin cere ca NATO să retragă de pe teritoriul estonian orice mijloace care reprezintă „o amenințare la adresa securității Federației Ruse”. Mai mult decât atât, Putin dorește ca Tallinn să acorde autonomie regională „Republicii Populare Narva” - un stat separatist pretins a fi declarat de minoritatea rusă din Estonia, dar care, în realitate, a fost inventat de Kremlin, apoi promovat fără milă pe rețelele sociale. Nu contează. A fost declarată legea marțială, sunt în curs de desfășurare atacuri cu drone „separatiste”, iar forțele estoniene au intrat deja în conflict cu navele de război ruse ancorate în Golful Tallinn.

latvia.title: Cum influențează consumul de zahăr din copilărie riscul de anxietate la maturitate: studiu realizat pe 45.000 de persoane
latvia.description: Consumul de zahăr în primii ani de viață ar putea avea efecte pe termen lung asupra sănătății mintale, arată un nou studiu realizat pe peste 45.000 de persoane. Cercetătorii au descoperit că persoanele expuse unui consum mai redus de zahăr în primele 1.000 de zile de viață au avut un risc de anxietate la maturitate cu 33% mai mic față de cele care nu au trecut prin astfel de restricții.

latvia.title: Un guvern AfD ar putea primi acces la secrete NATO. Berlinul caută o soluție pentru a proteja informațiile sensibile
latvia.description: Victoria AfD în alegerile din Saxonia-Anhalt a deschis o problemă fără precedent pentru Germania: cum poate fi protejat accesul la informații clasificate în cazul în care partidul ajunge la guvernare. Autoritățile federale analizează limitarea accesului unui eventual guvern AfD la anumite informații despre Rusia, grupările de extremă dreapta și planurile militare secrete ale Germaniei și aliaților săi. În centrul temerilor se află posibilitatea ca informații sensibile să ajungă la Moscova, dar și riscul ca serviciile de informații să-și compromită propriile operațiuni în cazul în care oficialii AfD ar putea afla identitatea unor agenți sub acoperire, anunță France24.

latvia.title: Cristian Diaconescu, semnal de alarmă privind strategia Rusiei: „Situația e la limită”. Cum poate Moscova să testeze solidaritatea NATO
latvia.description: Cristian Diaconescu, fost ministru de Externe, avertizează că Rusia ar putea testa solidaritatea NATO prin acțiuni menținute sub pragul unui atac militar direct, inclusiv prin incursiuni cu drone și operațiuni hibride. Invitat în exclusivitate la Digi24, Diaconescu a vorbit despre riscul unor provocări în spațiul Alianței și despre nevoia ca autoritățile să comunice publicului mai clar riscurile de securitate. În opinia sa, răspunsul trebuie să fie unul de încredere și determinare, nu de inducere a fricii.

latvia.title: Elvețienii au votat pentru păstrarea actualei neutralități. Referendumul privind înăsprirea regulilor a fost respins
latvia.description: Elvețienii au respins duminică, la referendum, inițiativa care urmărea înăsprirea regulilor privind neutralitatea țării, potrivit rezultatelor inițiale ale sondajelor de la ieșirea de la urne, relatează Agerpres, care citează AFP. Propunerea, înaintată de dreapta naționalistă, ar fi limitat cooperarea militară cu NATO și participarea Elveției la sancțiuni internaționale.

latvia.title: Petrișor Peiu reamintește momentul demiterii Cabinetului Bolojan, în contextul afirmațiilor atribuite ambasadoarei SUA în Grecia
latvia.description: Senatorul AUR Petrișor Peiu amintește, într-o postare în pagina sa de Facebook, cum a fost momentul demiterii Guvernului Bolojan, în urma moțiunii de cenzură. Precizările sale vin în contextul comentariilor care au apărut pe marginea unor afirmații atribuite ambasadoarei SUA în Grecia, Kimberly Ann Guifoyle, de publicația The Wall Street Journal, potrivit cărora SUA ar fi fost implicate în căderea Guvernului de la București.

latvia.title: Prima reacție a lui Grindeanu în scandalul ambasadoarei SUA în Grecia și dărâmarea Guvernului Bolojan
latvia.description: Președintele PSD, Sorin Grindeanu, a reacționat duminică după dezvăluirile apărute în cotidianul Wall Street Journal, care a scris că ambasadoarea Statelor Unite în Grecia s-ar fi lăudat că SUA ar fi avut o contribuție la căderea Guvernului Bolojan, în contextul în care și liderul social-democrat a avut o întâlnire cu ambasadoarea Kimberly Guilfoyle. Grindeanu acuză o tentativă de manipulare și declară că susține Parteneriatul Strategic cu SUA, „cel mai important aliat al nostru în NATO”. Totodată, el precizează în mesajul său că „PSD nu votează Guvernul Siegfried Vasile Mureșan”.

latvia.title: Ce au discutat în spatele ușilor închise ministrul german de Externe și Serghei Lavrov la prima întâlnire de la începutul războiului
latvia.description: Ministrul german de Externe, Johann Wadephul, i-a cerut Moscovei să „respingă calea periculoasă a escaladării” împotriva Germaniei, Europei și NATO, în prima discuție cu omologul rus Serghei Lavrov de la începutul invaziei ruse în Ucraina, potrivit Kyiv Post. Cei doi s-au întâlnit sâmbătă, la New York, în marja Adunării Generale a ONU. Ulterior, Wadephul l-a informat pe ministrul ucrainean de Externe, Andrii Sybiha, despre discuțiile purtate cu Lavrov.

latvia.title: Comandantul suprem al NATO solicită aliaților intensificarea schimbului de informații privind atacurile hibride
latvia.description: Generalul american Alexus Grynkewich, comandantul Suprem Aliat al NATO pentru Europa, dorește mai multe informații cu privire la amenințările hibride în creștere. El a solicitat aliaților să împărtășească mai multe informații despre atacurile hibride rusești, în contextul în care alianța se confruntă cu amenințări tot mai intense în întreaga Europă, relatează Politico.

latvia.title: MApN: O dronă a intrat în spațiul aerian național. Avioane de vânătoare și un elicopter militar au fost ridicate în aer
latvia.description: O dronă a intrat în spațiul aerian al României sâmbătă noapte, potrivit Ministerului Apărării Naționale (MApN), care precizează că au fost ridicate în aer două avioane F-18 spaniole și un elicopter IAR-330 SOCAT. Semnalul radar al țintei a fost pierdut în zona Pardina.

latvia.title: „Nu mai e un război hibrid”. Rusia își intensifică operațiunile în Europa: de la drone cu explozibili la nave de atac și sabotaje
latvia.description: Războiul din umbră atribuit Moscovei intră într-o nouă etapă, pe fondul incidentelor cu drone, al tentativelor de sabotaj și al unor confruntări tot mai riscante în apropierea teritoriului NATO. Germania a atribuit Rusiei atacul cu drone de la aeroportul Leipzig/Halle, iar Danemarca a acuzat un vas de război rus că a tras rachete de semnalizare în direcția unui elicopter militar. latvia.description: NATO would strike targets on another country's territory if needed to defend its members, NATO's top commander in Europe, Air Chief Marshal Sir Johnny Stringer told Postimees.

latvia.title: Court convicts Kohtla‑Järve drug ring connected to two substance‑related deaths
latvia.description: A court has convicted a Kohtla‑Järve drug gang led by a Latvian couple who trafficked narcotics from Latvia into Estonia.

latvia.title: Latvian central bank will discuss 'new geopolitical reality' in November
latvia.description: Latvijas Banka, the Latvian central bank (LB), has released a few details of its next annual conference, which "will focus on the economic challenges the euro area is facing in the new geopolitical reality."

latvia.title: Parties pore over polls in final days of Saeima election campaign
latvia.description: With just a few days to go before Latvia's parliamentary elections on October 3rd, parties continue to jostle for position, according to the latest data from the SKDS pollster produced for Latvian Television.

latvia.title: One final week of summer in store for Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that Latvia will experience summery weather this week.

latvia.title: Latvian parliamentary candidate's education info raises questions
latvia.description: Uncertainty has arisen regarding the educational background stated by Artūrs Butāns, a Member of the Saeima for the National Alliance (NA), in the last three Saeima elections, according to information compiled by the LETA news agency.

latvia.description: During the week of the 15th Saeima elections, from Monday 28 September to Friday 2 October, voters can cast their votes in advance. This can be done at any of the 933 polling stations across Latvia, according to the Central Election Commission (CVK).

latvia.title: Sunny and warm Monday in Latvia
latvia.description: Monday morning in Latvia is chilly, and foggy in many places, but the day is set to be sunny and warm, according to forecasts by Toms Bricis, LSM's weatherman.

latvia.title: Store-bought shelters a consideration for Latvia
latvia.description: To date, the main focus in establishing a network of bomb shelters in Latvia has been on identifying and adapting the basements of existing state and local authority buildings. latvia.description: In the phishing simulation campaigns carried out last year by the cyber incident response organisation ‘Cert.lv’, 31.5 per cent of the 15,436 emails sent were opened, according to the 2025 report on Latvian cyber security and Cert.lv’s technical activities.

latvia.title: Four Italian soldiers injured at Ādaži military base, Latvia
latvia.description: On Friday, 25 September, in the late afternoon, an incident occurred during a training exercise at the Ādaži military training area, in which four soldiers from the Italian contingent of the 11th Bersaglieri Regiment were injured, according to the National Armed Forces (NBS ).

latvia.description: Latvia is ready for the heating season, but people will most likely have to pay more for heating. The Ministry of Climate and Energy (KEM) estimates that, in the event of a mild or moderately cold winter, heating costs could rise by 10 to 15 per cent, Latvian Radio reported on September 25. In some local authorities, the increase may be even greater.

latvia.title: Two arrested in connection with child porn case in Latvia

latvia.title: Russian city names found painted over on Latvia's road signs
latvia.description: Several painted-over road signs have been spotted on the A12 motorway near Rēzekne, on which references to the Russian cities of Moscow and Ostrov have been obscured. The damaged road signs were spotted on Monday, 21 September, but it is not known exactly when they were painted over.

latvia.title: German Eurofighter jets arrive at Lielvārde air base
latvia.description: On Thursday, 24 September, four German Air Force ‘Eurofighter’ fighter jets arrived at the National Armed Forces’ ‘Lielvārde’ military base to temporarily reinforce the defence of Latvia’s airspace, said the Defence Ministry.

latvia.title: Some polling station staff in eastern Latvia replaced over security concerns
latvia.description: Several local authorities on the eastern border have been forced to make urgent changes to the staff at many polling stations. The State Security Service confirmed to the LSM Latgale editorial team on September 24 that a total of 6,000 polling station staff have been vetted across Latvia.

latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that prolonged rain is expected in many parts of Latvia on Friday, September 25.

latvia.description: Sergey Fedotov, the father of politician Jūlija Stepaņenko (Sovereign Power/Union of New Latvians), a candidate in the 15th Saeima elections, has recently come to public attention. On Thursday, Foreign Minister Baiba Braže (New Unity) added Fedotov to Latvia’s list of undesirable persons, barring him from entering the country for an indefinite period.

latvia.title: Border controls on grain shipments to be introduced in Latvia
latvia.description: To ensure that cargoes stolen in Ukraine, including grain, are not transported through Latvian territory, the Saeima adopted an amendment to the Animal Feed Circulation Law in its final reading on Thursday, 24 September, according to the Saeima’s press office.

latvia.title: Latvia will send up to 20 soldiers to clear Hormuz
latvia.description: On Thursday, 24 September, the Saeima approved the participation of the National Armed Forces (NBS) in multinational military operations to secure the Strait of Hormuz. Latvia plans to deploy up to 20 soldiers to clear the Strait of Hormuz of mines.

latvia.title: Man murders relative in Rīga, drops body on street
latvia.description: In mid-September, a woman showing signs of a violent death was found in Rīga, in the Jugla neighbourhood, near a block of flats, the State Police reported on September 24.

latvia.title: Charity concert for Ukraine to take place Sunday in Rīga
latvia.description: On 27 September at 5.00 pm, ‘Brūzis Manufaktūra’, Brīvības gatve 401, Rīga, will host the ‘Ganta Foundation’ charity concert and storytelling evening, ‘Stories That Must Be Heard’, the organisers announced.

latvia.title: Excise tax on fuel to be reduced in Latvia
latvia.description: On Thursday, 24 September, the Saeima approved, at its final reading, amendments to the Law on Limiting Price Increases for Petroleum Products, which provide for a reduction in the excise duty rate on diesel fuel and unleaded petrol from 1 October until the end of the year.

latvia.title: Saeima conceptually agrees to being audited
latvia.description: On Thursday, 24 September, the Saeima supported, at first reading, amendments granting the State Audit Office the right to carry out a financial audit of the accuracy of the annual report prepared by the Saeima.

latvia.description: Whilst Rīga is still waiting for a new concert hall, a multifunctional and modern concert hall has opened its doors nearby – in Salaspils, Latvian Television reported on September 23.

latvia.title: Latvia will host 2030 BMX world championship
latvia.description: Latvia has secured the right to host the BMX World Championships in Valmiera in 2030, and this will be the first time such a high-level competition has been held in a Baltic state, Toms Markss, Secretary General of the Latvian Cycling Federation (LRF), told Latvian Television.

latvia.description: ‘Sovereign Power/Union of New Latvians’ is among the frontrunners in the polls ahead of the Saeima elections expected in early October. Its Prime Minister candidate Jūlija Stepaņenko has in recent weeks avoided answering questions about her father, who lives in Russia and from whom she has received substantial gifts, Latvian Television reported on September 23.

latvia.description: The much-touted target date of 2030, by which the first phase of the “Rail Baltica” railway project – worth more than 14 billion euros – was due to be completed, is no longer a realistic prospect, as finally officially acknowledged by the leaders of the Baltic states, Latvian Radio reported on September 23.

latvia.description: Several draft laws aimed at reducing fuel prices are being put forward for approval by the Saeima. This was decided on Wednesday by the Saeima’s Budget and Finance (Tax) Committee, according to the Saeima Press Service.

latvia.title: Don't dump your apples in the nearest (or farthest) forest
latvia.description: With harvest in full swing, the question of where to put left-over apples, grass and other organic waste becomes more pressing for many home and garden owners.

latvia.title: Infection affects dozens of children in Salaspils kindergarten, Latvia
latvia.description: At the “Jāņtārpiņš” kindergarten in Salaspils, dozens of children have been found to be suffering from an illness of unknown origin. Similar symptoms have also been observed in several adults – members of the nursery staff. The Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (SPKC) has already launched an epidemiological investigation, and the Food and Veterinary Service (PVD) will carry out inspections on Wednesday, Latvian Radio reports.

latvia.title: Reminder issued to vaccinate dogs against canine distemper virus
latvia.description: Foxes in Ādaži Municipality have recently been laboratory-confirmed as infected with canine distemper (CDV); therefore, the Food and Veterinary Service (PVD) urges dog owners to ensure that their dog has been vaccinated against this highly contagious viral disease.

latvia.title: Latvians will get European-standard cards for disabled parking
latvia.description: To ensure that people with disabilities have uniform rights to use parking concessions throughout the European Union, the Latvian Ministry of Transport has drawn up amendments to the Road Traffic Regulations, which provide for a gradual transition from the current disabled parking card to the new European parking card.

latvia.title: Hacker detained in Latvia for at least two cyberattacks
latvia.description: On 15 September this year, the State Police arrested a hacker born in 2003 on suspicion of carrying out cyber-attacks against at least two Latvian companies for financial gain, the police said on September 23.

latvia.title: Latvia approves vague plan for curbing immigration
latvia.description: On Tuesday, 22 September, the Government endorsed the plan for measures to restrict immigration drawn up by the Ministry of the Interior (MoI), which includes more than 70 recommendations for controlling and restricting immigration.

latvia.title: Latvian government imposes restrictions on two Russian oligarchs
latvia.description: On Tuesday, the Latvian government imposed nationwide financial and entry restrictions on the Russian oligarchs Mikhail Fridman and Alisher Usmanov, according to documents attached to the agenda of the Cabinet of Ministers’ meeting.

latvia.description: What will the traffic situation be like in Rīga when the dilapidated Vanšu Bridge is repaired? With about a year to go before work begins, this remains unknown. latvia.description: The “Roadpol Safety Days” campaign, organised by the European traffic police network “Roadpol”, has come to an end. lithuania.title: Uniunea Europeană vrea să îşi consolideze răspunsul în fața atacurile hibride ruseşti
lithuania.description: Uniunea Europeană va discuta, luni, posibila înfiinţare a propriului mecanism de urgenţă, inspirat de cel al NATO, pentru a consolida răspunsul comun la „atacurile hibride” atribuite Moscovei, a indicat şefa politicii externe a UE, Kaja Kallas, relatează AFP, potrivit Agerpres.

lithuania.title: Europa, o broască în oala NATO pe focul întreținut de Putin. Scenariul rus de destrămare a alianței nord-atlantice: escaladare treptată
lithuania.description: Cum ar putea arăta un război între Rusia și NATO? Jurnalistul Michael Kranz oferă un posibil scenariu pe platforma Unherd. În largul insulei Hiiumaa, istoria este pe cale să se scrie. O flotă combinată de nave de război ale NATO - condusă de distrugătoare ale Marinei Regale Britanice și alcătuită din reprezentanți ai cinci țări - se îndreaptă spre această insulă bătută de vânturi, situată la gura Golfului Finlandei. Chiar în față se află Flota Baltică a Rusiei, care, în ultimele 36 de ore, a încercat să impună un blocaj naval asupra Estoniei. Mai la est, s-au adunat și 100.000 de soldați ruși, iar Vladimir Putin cere ca NATO să retragă de pe teritoriul estonian orice mijloace care reprezintă „o amenințare la adresa securității Federației Ruse”. Mai mult decât atât, Putin dorește ca Tallinn să acorde autonomie regională „Republicii Populare Narva” - un stat separatist pretins a fi declarat de minoritatea rusă din Estonia, dar care, în realitate, a fost inventat de Kremlin, apoi promovat fără milă pe rețelele sociale. Nu contează. A fost declarată legea marțială, sunt în curs de desfășurare atacuri cu drone „separatiste”, iar forțele estoniene au intrat deja în conflict cu navele de război ruse ancorate în Golful Tallinn.

lithuania.title: Cum influențează consumul de zahăr din copilărie riscul de anxietate la maturitate: studiu realizat pe 45.000 de persoane
lithuania.description: Consumul de zahăr în primii ani de viață ar putea avea efecte pe termen lung asupra sănătății mintale, arată un nou studiu realizat pe peste 45.000 de persoane. Cercetătorii au descoperit că persoanele expuse unui consum mai redus de zahăr în primele 1.000 de zile de viață au avut un risc de anxietate la maturitate cu 33% mai mic față de cele care nu au trecut prin astfel de restricții.

lithuania.title: Un guvern AfD ar putea primi acces la secrete NATO. Berlinul caută o soluție pentru a proteja informațiile sensibile
lithuania.description: Victoria AfD în alegerile din Saxonia-Anhalt a deschis o problemă fără precedent pentru Germania: cum poate fi protejat accesul la informații clasificate în cazul în care partidul ajunge la guvernare. Autoritățile federale analizează limitarea accesului unui eventual guvern AfD la anumite informații despre Rusia, grupările de extremă dreapta și planurile militare secrete ale Germaniei și aliaților săi. În centrul temerilor se află posibilitatea ca informații sensibile să ajungă la Moscova, dar și riscul ca serviciile de informații să-și compromită propriile operațiuni în cazul în care oficialii AfD ar putea afla identitatea unor agenți sub acoperire, anunță France24.

lithuania.title: Cristian Diaconescu, semnal de alarmă privind strategia Rusiei: „Situația e la limită”. Cum poate Moscova să testeze solidaritatea NATO
lithuania.description: Cristian Diaconescu, fost ministru de Externe, avertizează că Rusia ar putea testa solidaritatea NATO prin acțiuni menținute sub pragul unui atac militar direct, inclusiv prin incursiuni cu drone și operațiuni hibride. Invitat în exclusivitate la Digi24, Diaconescu a vorbit despre riscul unor provocări în spațiul Alianței și despre nevoia ca autoritățile să comunice publicului mai clar riscurile de securitate. În opinia sa, răspunsul trebuie să fie unul de încredere și determinare, nu de inducere a fricii.

lithuania.title: Elvețienii au votat pentru păstrarea actualei neutralități. Referendumul privind înăsprirea regulilor a fost respins
lithuania.description: Elvețienii au respins duminică, la referendum, inițiativa care urmărea înăsprirea regulilor privind neutralitatea țării, potrivit rezultatelor inițiale ale sondajelor de la ieșirea de la urne, relatează Agerpres, care citează AFP. Propunerea, înaintată de dreapta naționalistă, ar fi limitat cooperarea militară cu NATO și participarea Elveției la sancțiuni internaționale.

lithuania.title: Petrișor Peiu reamintește momentul demiterii Cabinetului Bolojan, în contextul afirmațiilor atribuite ambasadoarei SUA în Grecia
lithuania.description: Senatorul AUR Petrișor Peiu amintește, într-o postare în pagina sa de Facebook, cum a fost momentul demiterii Guvernului Bolojan, în urma moțiunii de cenzură. Precizările sale vin în contextul comentariilor care au apărut pe marginea unor afirmații atribuite ambasadoarei SUA în Grecia, Kimberly Ann Guifoyle, de publicația The Wall Street Journal, potrivit cărora SUA ar fi fost implicate în căderea Guvernului de la București.

lithuania.title: Prima reacție a lui Grindeanu în scandalul ambasadoarei SUA în Grecia și dărâmarea Guvernului Bolojan
lithuania.description: Președintele PSD, Sorin Grindeanu, a reacționat duminică după dezvăluirile apărute în cotidianul Wall Street Journal, care a scris că ambasadoarea Statelor Unite în Grecia s-ar fi lăudat că SUA ar fi avut o contribuție la căderea Guvernului Bolojan, în contextul în care și liderul social-democrat a avut o întâlnire cu ambasadoarea Kimberly Guilfoyle. Grindeanu acuză o tentativă de manipulare și declară că susține Parteneriatul Strategic cu SUA, „cel mai important aliat al nostru în NATO”. Totodată, el precizează în mesajul său că „PSD nu votează Guvernul Siegfried Vasile Mureșan”.

lithuania.title: Ce au discutat în spatele ușilor închise ministrul german de Externe și Serghei Lavrov la prima întâlnire de la începutul războiului

Cei doi s-au întâlnit sâmbătă, la New York, în marja Adunării Generale a ONU. Ulterior, Wadephul l-a informat pe ministrul ucrainean de Externe, Andrii Sybiha, despre discuțiile purtate cu Lavrov.

lithuania.title: Comandantul suprem al NATO solicită aliaților intensificarea schimbului de informații privind atacurile hibride
lithuania.description: Generalul american Alexus Grynkewich, comandantul Suprem Aliat al NATO pentru Europa, dorește mai multe informații cu privire la amenințările hibride în creștere. El a solicitat aliaților să împărtășească mai multe informații despre atacurile hibride rusești, în contextul în care alianța se confruntă cu amenințări tot mai intense în întreaga Europă, relatează Politico.

lithuania.description: Războiul din umbră atribuit Moscovei intră într-o nouă etapă, pe fondul incidentelor cu drone, al tentativelor de sabotaj și al unor confruntări tot mai riscante în apropierea teritoriului NATO.
